tuples.mechanism: flood-fed grain feeds towns no desert army could supply, so the delta decides who eats
tuples.evidence_lens: flood-farming systems studied against the grain tribute named in chronicles

tuples.episode_object: a gold ingot carried north to a mint
tuples.time_place_scope: the routes from the southern goldfields, the 1590s
tuples.mechanism: gold that leaves by ship from the coast stops paying the desert crossing and its taxers
tuples.evidence_lens: European coastal trade records compared with North African mint output

tuples.episode_object: a mud-brick mosque maintained by townsmen
tuples.time_place_scope: Timbuktu and Jenne, the fourteenth to sixteenth centuries
tuples.mechanism: religious buildings kept up by townspeople outlast the rulers who first endowed them
tuples.evidence_lens: building phases in the mosques dated against endowments named in chronicles

tuples.episode_object: a chronicle written two generations after the defeat
tuples.mechanism: histories written under occupiers explain a defeat in terms their patrons could accept
tuples.evidence_lens: the two town chronicles compared on the same events and on their differences

tuples.episode_object: a sale record for a captive in a market
tuples.time_place_scope: the Niger bend, the seventeenth century
tuples.mechanism: raiding for captives replaces taxing settled farmers once a state stops governing them
tuples.evidence_lens: raiding notices in chronicles compared with the trade recorded on both coasts

tuples.episode_object: an investiture document sent from the north
tuples.time_place_scope: the Timbuktu pashalik, the seventeenth century
tuples.mechanism: a garrison that starts electing its own commanders becomes a local dynasty in all but name
tuples.evidence_lens: the succession of commanders in local records set against Moroccan claims

tuples.episode_object: an abandoned granary on a river bank
tuples.time_place_scope: the middle Niger valley, the seventeenth century
tuples.mechanism: when no single power collects, farmers pay whichever armed band is nearest that season
tuples.evidence_lens: settlement survey data compared with tax notices in the later chronicles

tuples.episode_object: a nomad confederation's camp near the towns
tuples.time_place_scope: the southern Sahara fringe, the eighteenth century
tuples.mechanism: a weakened river power lets desert confederations tax the towns the old order protected
tuples.evidence_lens: later chronicles and travellers' accounts compared on who collected in the towns

coverage_profiles.subject: the kingdom of Kongo and Portuguese contact

tuples.episode_object: a stone pillar cut with royal arms set at a river mouth
tuples.mechanism: a dated marker at a navigable mouth turns a landfall into a claim later crews can find
tuples.evidence_lens: the surviving pillars and their inscriptions read against the voyage chronicles

tuples.episode_object: a baptismal entry naming a ruler and his household
tuples.mechanism: a rite from foreign clergy binds a court to a distant church without altering its succession
tuples.evidence_lens: Portuguese chronicles compared with mission-recorded oral tradition of the same events

tuples.episode_object: a letter under royal seal protesting that traders were taking free subjects
tuples.mechanism: writing in the partner's language and law gives a ruler standing inside the partner's courts
tuples.evidence_lens: the letters kept in Lisbon read for scribal hands and for what went unanswered

tuples.episode_object: a plantation account of captives received and forwarded
tuples.time_place_scope: Sao Tome island, the early sixteenth century
tuples.mechanism: an offshore island with mills and a customs house grades and taxes a coastal trade
tuples.evidence_lens: island tithe and customs accounts set beside planters' surviving correspondence

tuples.episode_object: a royal instruction listing masons, priests and craftsmen to be sent overseas
tuples.mechanism: sending skills rather than goods makes technical dependence the price of an alliance
tuples.evidence_lens: instruction texts compared with what the receiving court asked for in its own letters

tuples.episode_object: a tally of nzimbu shells gathered under licence
tuples.time_place_scope: Luanda island and the shell fisheries, the sixteenth century
tuples.mechanism: holding the one beach that yields a realm's currency squeezes its money without a battle
tuples.evidence_lens: shells from coastal middens weighed against treasury references to fixed measures

tuples.episode_object: an order sending a governor to a province for a fixed term
tuples.time_place_scope: Nsundi and the eastern provinces, the sixteenth century
tuples.mechanism: rotating provincial governors from the capital stops a province breeding a rival dynasty
tuples.evidence_lens: officeholder lists rebuilt from mission reports and later regnal tradition

tuples.episode_object: credentials carried by an embassy to a papal court
tuples.mechanism: recognition by a third sovereign lets a weaker partner appeal over its trading neighbour
tuples.evidence_lens: curial records of the audience compared with the embassy's own memorials

tuples.episode_object: a governor's grant of land and labour to new settlers
tuples.mechanism: founding a rival port south of a kingdom's harbours diverts caravans and starves customs
tuples.evidence_lens: settlement charters set against later returns from the two competing harbours

tuples.episode_object: a campaign muster listing African archers serving with a European force
tuples.mechanism: hiring local infantry in bulk lets a small garrison reach far past its own numbers
tuples.evidence_lens: pay lists and campaign diaries counted for auxiliaries per European soldier

tuples.episode_object: a protest letter to a colonial governor over an unprovoked raid
tuples.mechanism: a raid launched without the metropolitan crown's order tests who an alliance actually binds
tuples.evidence_lens: letters between the two courts read alongside the governor's recall proceedings

tuples.episode_object: a treaty of alliance between an African court and a Protestant company
tuples.mechanism: a second buyer in the same harbour lets a supplier bid the two against each other
tuples.evidence_lens: company correspondence from the occupation years set against arms shipped inland

tuples.episode_object: a battlefield return of muskets, standards and prisoners taken
tuples.mechanism: massed firearms in ranks beat a larger army whose strength lies in archers and shieldmen
tuples.evidence_lens: the two battle narratives compared for counts, and the ground surveyed for shot

tuples.episode_object: sailing orders for a punitive landing on a coastal province
tuples.time_place_scope: Soyo and the coast at Kitombo, 1670
tuples.mechanism: a province that buys its own guns and drills musketeers can beat what beat the capital
tuples.evidence_lens: the losing side's expedition records read with accounts collected by resident priests

tuples.episode_object: a rival claimant's proclamation issued away from an abandoned capital
tuples.time_place_scope: Mbanza Kongo after 1665, the later seventeenth century
tuples.mechanism: once the election council disperses, every provincial house can claim and none be refused
tuples.evidence_lens: excavated evidence of abandonment at the capital dated against succession lists

tuples.episode_object: a missionary interrogation record of a prophetic movement
tuples.mechanism: a popular call to resettle the capital raises a following no grant of office could buy
tuples.evidence_lens: Capuchin depositions, the only written record, read beside later oral tradition

tuples.episode_object: an order for rebuilding a ruined capital's churches and market
tuples.mechanism: reoccupying the coronation site turns a partial victory into recognised kingship
tuples.evidence_lens: mission reports of resettlement compared with archaeology of the rebuilt structures

tuples.episode_object: an annual baptismal count returned to a mission superior
tuples.time_place_scope: Capuchin mission stations, the mid seventeenth century
tuples.mechanism: quotas of rites reported upward make priests the region's most regular counters of people
tuples.evidence_lens: annual station returns aggregated and tested against independent settlement estimates

tuples.episode_object: a licence to load cargo at a named royal harbour
tuples.time_place_scope: Mpinda and the Atlantic ports, the sixteenth century
tuples.mechanism: restricting lawful loading to one harbour makes the customs house where a crown taxes trade
tuples.evidence_lens: port licences compared with ships attested arriving at unlicensed beaches

tuples.episode_object: a fair's toll schedule listing goods and their duties
tuples.time_place_scope: the Angolan interior markets, the eighteenth century
tuples.mechanism: inland markets policed from outside move frontier profit into a neighbour's treasury
tuples.evidence_lens: toll schedules across years compared with caravan routes from traders' journals

tuples.episode_object: a churchwardens' inventory of images broken or removed
tuples.mechanism: stripping parish churches in one summer forces magistrates to choose townsmen or crown
tuples.evidence_lens: parish inventories taken before and after that summer, town by town

tuples.episode_object: a sentence roll from a special tribunal on treason and heresy
tuples.mechanism: trying nobles outside the provinces' own charters makes a religious quarrel constitutional
tuples.evidence_lens: tribunal sentence lists counted by province, rank and outcome

tuples.episode_object: a privateer's commission naming a patron and a share of prize
tuples.mechanism: raiders obliged to sell prizes in friendly ports make those towns stakeholders in the war
tuples.evidence_lens: admiralty prize records set against the order in which towns changed side

tuples.episode_object: an assessment schedule for a proposed tax of one penny in ten
tuples.mechanism: a permanent turnover tax levied without consent breaks the bargain that towns vote subsidies
tuples.evidence_lens: estates' minutes on the tax compared with subsidies actually granted in earlier years

tuples.episode_object: an order to cut a sea dyke and flood the surrounding polders
tuples.mechanism: deliberate flooding removes the dry ground a besieging army needs for camps and carts
tuples.evidence_lens: dyke board repair accounts matched with journals kept inside the besieged town

tuples.episode_object: a garrison's back-pay account carried by mutineers
tuples.mechanism: an unpaid professional army sacks the richest city it holds and ruins its own paymaster
tuples.evidence_lens: army pay ledgers for the preceding months read with the city's damage assessments

tuples.episode_object: an agreement between provinces to suspend religious prosecution
tuples.mechanism: postponing the religious question is what lets opposite confessions share one army
tuples.evidence_lens: the clauses compared with how each signatory province then policed worship

tuples.episode_object: articles of reconciliation with the crown signed by provincial deputies
tuples.mechanism: guaranteeing noble office and one confession buys back gentry who feared their own towns
tuples.evidence_lens: signatory lists cross-checked against landholding and officeholding in those provinces

tuples.episode_object: articles of union binding provinces to common defence
tuples.mechanism: a defensive treaty leaving each province its laws builds a state by subtraction
tuples.evidence_lens: the articles read clause by clause against the later practice of the generality

tuples.episode_object: an act renouncing allegiance to a reigning sovereign
tuples.mechanism: casting deposition as a prince's breach of contract lets subjects claim to keep the law
tuples.evidence_lens: the act's wording compared with the privileges it cites and the preceding pamphlets

tuples.episode_object: an engineer's drawing for a bridge of boats across a tidal river
tuples.mechanism: closing a great river below a city starves it faster than assaulting its walls
tuples.evidence_lens: siege engineering plans set against grain prices inside the blockaded city

tuples.episode_object: a toll register kept at a river fort
tuples.mechanism: holding the seaward end of a river lets a rival tax or refuse all traffic above it
tuples.evidence_lens: toll registers compared with shipping entries at the rival northern ports

tuples.episode_object: a subscription list for a voyage to the Indies
tuples.mechanism: pooling small shares in single voyages spreads loss enough for a town to risk far routes
tuples.evidence_lens: subscription lists for successive voyages compared for how many names repeat

tuples.episode_object: a siege train's inventory of guns, pioneers and barges
tuples.time_place_scope: the IJssel and Rhine river towns, the 1590s
tuples.mechanism: moving artillery by water takes several walled towns a season instead of one a year
tuples.evidence_lens: campaign transport costs read with the dates each town capitulated

tuples.episode_object: a billeting schedule for troops marching through allied territory
tuples.time_place_scope: the road from Lombardy to Flanders, the 1580s and 1590s
tuples.mechanism: an army supplied overland across other men's states pays in delay, and delay in mutiny
tuples.evidence_lens: march itineraries compared with the recorded dates and places of mutinies

tuples.episode_object: a fortification plan of earth bastions and outworks
tuples.mechanism: low earthen bastions absorb shot that shatters stone, so few men hold out for years
tuples.evidence_lens: excavated bastion profiles compared with the published plans of the same works

tuples.episode_object: a chartered company's founding grant of monopoly and war powers
tuples.mechanism: letting a trading company make treaties and keep troops exports war at investors' cost
tuples.evidence_lens: the charter's clauses tested against the company's first decade of expenditure

tuples.episode_object: a bond issued by a provincial treasury at a stated rate
tuples.mechanism: borrowing cheaply against reliable excise lets a small state outspend a far larger one
tuples.evidence_lens: provincial bond rates compared with the crown's borrowing costs over the same span

tuples.episode_object: the canons and acts of a national church synod
tuples.mechanism: settling doctrine by national assembly lets the convening faction purge magistracies too
tuples.evidence_lens: the synod's acts read with lists of ministers deprived and councils altered

tuples.episode_object: an instrument of ratification exchanged between two crowns
tuples.mechanism: recognition in treaty lets a de facto state hold ambassadors, alliances and colonies
tuples.evidence_lens: the ratified text compared with the earlier truce, article against article

tuples.episode_object: a field return listing captured war elephants and guns
tuples.mechanism: winning the plain north of a capital decides who collects that year's harvest revenue
tuples.evidence_lens: chronicle accounts of the battle compared for orders of battle and spoils

tuples.episode_object: an order transferring a revenue assignment from one officer to another
tuples.mechanism: an assignment movable at will stops a commander turning his paying district into an estate
tuples.evidence_lens: transfer orders traced for individual officers across successive years

tuples.episode_object: a remission order cancelling a levy on pilgrims
tuples.mechanism: dropping a tax that falls on one community buys consent more cheaply than it costs
tuples.evidence_lens: the remission's wording compared with what that levy had yielded in earlier accounts

tuples.episode_object: a marriage settlement recorded between two ruling houses
tuples.mechanism: taking a chief's daughter and then his sons into service makes a rival a salaried officer
tuples.evidence_lens: Rajput genealogies matched with the service ranks their men later held

tuples.episode_object: a mine gallery driven under a fortress curtain wall
tuples.mechanism: reducing the two greatest hill forts tells smaller garrisons that walls will not save them
tuples.evidence_lens: the fortifications surveyed for breach and repair, read with the siege chronicle

tuples.episode_object: a descriptive roll of a trooper with his horse's brand mark
tuples.time_place_scope: the imperial camp and its musters, the 1570s
tuples.mechanism: branding horses and describing men stops officers drawing pay for troopers they lack
tuples.evidence_lens: muster rolls compared with the contract strengths recorded for the same commanders

tuples.episode_object: a customs farm contract for a seaport
tuples.mechanism: annexing a maritime province gives a land empire a sea income ploughland cannot raise
tuples.evidence_lens: port customs figures in the imperial gazetteer set against earlier sultanate accounts

tuples.episode_object: a river flotilla's boat list with crews and guns
tuples.mechanism: in a delta whoever controls the boats wins, since roads carry neither siege guns nor grain
tuples.evidence_lens: campaign narratives compared with boat and crew numbers in the administrative manual

tuples.episode_object: a mason's contract for quarried red sandstone
tuples.mechanism: a capital built on a chosen site puts the household clear of old entrenched interests
tuples.evidence_lens: quarry and building accounts compared with the standing fabric and its phases

tuples.episode_object: an attestation signed by senior jurists on a ruler's authority to decide
tuples.time_place_scope: the hall of debate at Sikri, 1575-1579
tuples.mechanism: signatures affirming a right to choose among valid opinions move the last word to the throne
tuples.evidence_lens: the attestation's text compared with a contemporary critic's hostile account

tuples.episode_object: a ten-year schedule of average prices and yields by crop
tuples.time_place_scope: the revenue districts of the doab, 1580
tuples.mechanism: averaging past yields fixes a cash demand in advance, so the state stops betting on harvests
tuples.evidence_lens: district assessments compared across two settlements a decade apart

tuples.episode_object: a baggage inventory for moving an entire court and treasury
tuples.mechanism: shifting the capital toward a threatened frontier puts guard and treasury a march away
tuples.evidence_lens: dated chancery documents plotted by place of issue, year by year

tuples.episode_object: a toll register kept at a mountain defile
tuples.mechanism: holding the passes turns a frontier from a place raiders cross into a place taxed
tuples.evidence_lens: toll registers compared with the recorded frequency of raids on caravans

tuples.episode_object: a survey of saffron and shawl-wool assessments
tuples.mechanism: a valley with one high-value crop yields income needing no garrison spread across it
tuples.evidence_lens: the valley's assessed revenue in the imperial compilation set against local records

tuples.episode_object: articles of submission accepted from a provincial ruler
tuples.mechanism: submission on terms keeps the local revenue machinery running through a change of master
tuples.evidence_lens: terms in the court histories compared with chronicles written inside the province

tuples.episode_object: a handover receipt for a fortress's stores and artillery
tuples.mechanism: a fortress taken by negotiated transfer costs no siege train and keeps its magazines
tuples.evidence_lens: Mughal and Safavid narratives of the handover compared for what each omits

tuples.episode_object: a diplomatic letter demanding acknowledgement of overlordship
tuples.mechanism: demanding recognition before invading makes refusal rebellion rather than war between equals
tuples.evidence_lens: correspondence preserved on both sides read against the sequence of campaigns

tuples.episode_object: a mint's assay record for a silver issue
tuples.time_place_scope: the imperial mint towns, the later sixteenth century
tuples.mechanism: a coin of stable weight accepted everywhere lets cash dues be met from market sales
tuples.evidence_lens: surviving coins weighed by mint and year against the standards in the manual

tuples.episode_object: a presentation manuscript of a Sanskrit epic rendered into Persian
tuples.time_place_scope: the translation workshop at court, the 1580s
tuples.mechanism: rendering conquered classics into the ruling tongue reads them without empowering them
tuples.evidence_lens: surviving illustrated copies collated for colophons and named translators

tuples.episode_object: a statistical compilation of provinces with their revenue totals
tuples.time_place_scope: Agra and the imperial offices, the 1590s
tuples.mechanism: one published account of every province's assessment lets the centre rank its governors
tuples.evidence_lens: the compilation's figures checked against surviving provincial documents

tuples.episode_object: pledges of loyalty sealed before a battle
tuples.mechanism: written defections secured beforehand make the battle confirm what negotiation arranged
tuples.evidence_lens: oath documents dated before the engagement compared with who actually changed sides

tuples.episode_object: an imperial patent conferring an old military title
tuples.mechanism: taking an old court title lets a new regime claim to restore an office, not found a throne
tuples.evidence_lens: the patent's wording compared with earlier grants of the same title

tuples.episode_object: a retired ruler's memorandum of instructions to his successor
tuples.mechanism: giving a son the title while keeping the power proves heredity before anyone contests it
tuples.evidence_lens: documents issued from the retirement seat counted against those from the new capital

tuples.episode_object: a post station's schedule of horses and porters kept ready
tuples.mechanism: villages obliged to keep relay horses let orders travel faster than rivals can assemble
tuples.evidence_lens: post obligations recorded in village papers compared along the route

tuples.episode_object: a mine's output tally rendered to a magistrate
tuples.time_place_scope: Sado island and the Iwami silver district, the early seventeenth century
tuples.mechanism: direct rule over the richest mines gives bullion no provincial lord can tax or intercept
tuples.evidence_lens: mine output records set against the dated coin issues struck from that metal

tuples.episode_object: an allocation of stone-wall sections to named lords
tuples.time_place_scope: Edo and the daimyo work gangs, 1604-1640
tuples.mechanism: making lords build the centre's castle at their cost drains what they would fortify with
tuples.evidence_lens: masons' marks on the surviving walls matched to the domains assigned each section

tuples.episode_object: an inscription on a temple bell taken as an affront
tuples.mechanism: a pretext found in writing opens a war already decided while appearing to be provoked
tuples.evidence_lens: the bell, which survives, read with the legal opinions solicited about its wording

tuples.episode_object: a demolition return listing castles pulled down in a province
tuples.time_place_scope: the provinces after the castle order, 1615
tuples.mechanism: one fortress per province removes the strongholds a rising would need before it began
tuples.evidence_lens: demolition returns compared with archaeological survey of abandoned castle sites

tuples.episode_object: a code of conduct issued to courtiers and the throne
tuples.mechanism: writing down what a court may do makes ceremony a licensed activity rather than a power
tuples.evidence_lens: the code's articles compared with the court's actual appointments afterwards

tuples.episode_object: a trade agreement fixing the number of ships permitted each year
tuples.mechanism: delegating a whole foreign relationship to one border domain keeps contact countable
tuples.evidence_lens: the agreed ship quotas checked against the domain's own record of voyages made

tuples.episode_object: an oath of submission with a survey of island landholdings
tuples.mechanism: leaving a conquered king in place while assessing his land draws revenue from unnamed trade
tuples.evidence_lens: island survey figures compared with the tribute the domain reported to the centre

tuples.episode_object: a magistrate's register of resident foreign merchants
tuples.mechanism: confining foreign trade to one supervised harbour turns an open coast into a single gate
tuples.evidence_lens: the magistracy's registers compared with ports where foreign ships had called before

tuples.episode_object: a vermilion-seal pass issued to a shipowner
tuples.time_place_scope: the licensed trading routes to southeast Asia, 1604-1635
tuples.mechanism: licensing voyages one by one makes the right to sail depend on continuing favour
tuples.evidence_lens: surviving passes counted by year and destination against foreign port records

tuples.episode_object: a besieging force's ammunition and rations account
tuples.mechanism: a rising by overtaxed peasants under a banned faith supplies the case for closing a country
tuples.evidence_lens: siege accounts compared with the domain's assessed land tax in preceding years

tuples.episode_object: a daybook kept by a factory chief on an artificial island
tuples.mechanism: an island reached by one bridge lets trade continue while every conversation is watched
tuples.evidence_lens: factory daybooks read for what they record of guards, interpreters and inspections

tuples.episode_object: a residence order requiring wives and heirs to remain in the capital
tuples.time_place_scope: Edo and the domain capitals, the 1630s
tuples.mechanism: keeping a lord's family in the ruler's city makes revolt cost his household first
tuples.evidence_lens: capital compound records compared with the years each domain came under the rule

tuples.episode_object: a temple certificate attesting a household's affiliation
tuples.time_place_scope: the villages of the Kinai, the mid seventeenth century
tuples.mechanism: vouching every household through a temple makes registration a census and a loyalty test
tuples.evidence_lens: village registers compared across decades for household composition and movement

tuples.episode_object: a building account for a mausoleum complex
tuples.mechanism: enshrining a founder as a deity gives a house a site outranking any rival's ancestors
tuples.evidence_lens: construction accounts and donation lists compared with attendance at commemorations

tuples.episode_object: a trading post's exchange rate for salmon and rice
tuples.time_place_scope: Ezo and the Matsumae domain, the seventeenth century
tuples.mechanism: a domain with no rice land is paid in a trade monopoly instead of assessed fields
tuples.evidence_lens: trading post records compared with goods found archaeologically in northern sites

tuples.episode_object: a transfer order moving a lord to a distant province
tuples.time_place_scope: the confiscated domains of western Japan, 1600-1651
tuples.mechanism: moving lords between provinces cuts ties to retainers and shrines built by long residence
tuples.evidence_lens: confiscations and transfers counted by decade and by the size of holdings involved

tuples.episode_object: a sheriff's assessment for a levy to furnish ships
tuples.mechanism: extending a coastal levy inland without consent makes a naval charge a test of prerogative
tuples.evidence_lens: county assessment and arrears records compared before and after the test case

tuples.episode_object: a subscription roll of signatures to a national covenant
tuples.mechanism: a document circulated for mass signature turns scattered discontent into a countable body
tuples.evidence_lens: surviving covenant copies compared for their signatory lists and regional spread

tuples.episode_object: a paymaster's account for an army raised without a voted subsidy
tuples.mechanism: a war fought on borrowed money forces a crown to call the assembly it has avoided
tuples.evidence_lens: army pay and loan records set against the dates of the summons to parliament

tuples.episode_object: a bill of attainder passed against a chief minister
tuples.mechanism: condemning a minister by statute removes the need to prove treason at law
tuples.evidence_lens: the attainder traced through the journals and the recorded division lists

tuples.episode_object: a sworn deposition taken from a dispossessed settler
tuples.mechanism: atrocity reports arriving as an army is raised make command of that army unagreeable
tuples.evidence_lens: the deposition collections sorted for first-hand, hearsay and later addition

tuples.episode_object: a newsbook printing the proceedings of a sitting parliament
tuples.mechanism: when licensing lapses, weekly print carries a national argument at the speed of the post
tuples.evidence_lens: dated pamphlet holdings counted by month across the collapse of licensing

tuples.episode_object: an inventory of an arsenal's stored arms and powder
tuples.mechanism: whoever holds the stored arsenals sets how large an army the other side can field first
tuples.evidence_lens: magazine inventories compared with the numbers each side actually armed that summer

tuples.episode_object: a commission of array read out at a market cross
tuples.time_place_scope: the county towns raising forces, summer 1642
tuples.mechanism: two rival legal instruments for calling the militia force each county to pick an authority
tuples.evidence_lens: county records of which instrument was executed where, mapped against allegiance

tuples.episode_object: a field officer's account of a cavalry charge and its aftermath
tuples.mechanism: horse that pursue off the field leave infantry to decide a battle neither can finish
tuples.evidence_lens: participants' narratives compared for sequence, and the ground walked against them

tuples.episode_object: a receipt for college plate taken to be coined
tuples.mechanism: melting borrowed plate funds a court that has lost its customs revenue, but only once
tuples.evidence_lens: plate receipts compared with the surviving emergency coinage struck from it

tuples.episode_object: a county committee's monthly assessment warrant
tuples.mechanism: a fixed monthly county charge collected locally pays troops regularly enough to keep them
tuples.evidence_lens: assessment warrants and receipts compared county by county with mutiny reports

tuples.episode_object: a treaty of military alliance bringing a neighbouring army into a war
tuples.mechanism: buying a neighbouring kingdom's army with a religious promise shifts one campaign's balance
tuples.evidence_lens: the alliance terms compared with troops actually fielded and the promise's later fate

tuples.episode_object: a directory of public worship replacing an older liturgy
tuples.time_place_scope: Westminster and the assembly of divines, 1643-1649
tuples.mechanism: a liturgy is easy to vote away and hard to replace, so settlement outlasts the fighting
tuples.evidence_lens: parish records checked for which form of service was actually used afterwards

tuples.episode_object: a captured cabinet of a king's private correspondence
tuples.mechanism: printing a defeated party's own letters destroys the bargaining position defeat left it
tuples.evidence_lens: the printed edition compared with surviving originals for selection and omission

tuples.episode_object: articles drawn up by neighbourhood associations against plunder
tuples.time_place_scope: the west country and its armed countrymen, 1645
tuples.mechanism: villagers arming against both armies show free quarter turns a countryside, not doctrine
tuples.evidence_lens: the associations' articles compared with quartering complaints in the same districts

tuples.episode_object: a coal shipment return for the winter trade to a capital
tuples.mechanism: cutting a capital's fuel is slower than a siege but reaches every household in it
tuples.evidence_lens: coastal shipping returns and fuel prices compared across the blockade months

tuples.episode_object: a shorthand record of a council debate on the franchise
tuples.mechanism: an unpaid army debates the constitution because disbanding unsettled means arrest
tuples.evidence_lens: the debate transcript read with the army's arrears accounts and its petitions

tuples.episode_object: a set of settlement proposals offered to a captive king
tuples.time_place_scope: the army headquarters and the Isle of Wight, 1647-1648
tuples.mechanism: a beaten party that can still negotiate with several winners prolongs a lost war
tuples.evidence_lens: successive draft settlements compared for what each side would concede over time

tuples.episode_object: a commission constituting a court to try a head of state
tuples.mechanism: trying a king before a court made by one chamber puts the trial's legality on trial
tuples.evidence_lens: the court's own record compared with pamphlet accounts printed within weeks

tuples.episode_object: a survey of forfeited land measured for redistribution
tuples.time_place_scope: Ireland and Scotland under the commonwealth, 1649-1652
tuples.mechanism: paying soldiers in confiscated land exports one kingdom's war cost onto another's owners
tuples.evidence_lens: survey maps compared with later rentals to see who actually took possession

tuples.episode_object: a manifesto listing grievances against a neighbouring court
tuples.time_place_scope: Liaodong and the Ming frontier garrisons, 1618-1626
tuples.mechanism: publishing a list of wrongs converts a tributary's raiding into declared war with aims
tuples.evidence_lens: the manifesto's text compared with frontier reports of the incidents it names

tuples.episode_object: a banner register enrolling households under company captains
tuples.mechanism: organising every household into companies makes the army and the census one document
tuples.evidence_lens: banner registers compared across decades for absorption of non-Manchu households

tuples.episode_object: a seal conferred on a steppe prince by a rising court
tuples.mechanism: granting ranks and seals to steppe nobles buys cavalry without conquering their pastures
tuples.evidence_lens: surviving seals and investitures matched with the contingents those princes supplied

tuples.episode_object: a monument recording terms imposed after an invasion
tuples.mechanism: forcing a neighbour to transfer its tribute removes an ally and confirms a new court's rank
tuples.evidence_lens: the inscription compared with Korean court records of the same negotiation

tuples.episode_object: a county report of tax arrears and abandoned households
tuples.mechanism: war surtaxes demanded during crop failure turn disbanded couriers into rebel cadres
tuples.evidence_lens: gazetteer entries on famine and arrears compared with recorded origins of rebel bands

tuples.episode_object: a treasury statement of unpaid garrison wages
tuples.mechanism: a capital whose garrison is unpaid falls to whoever brings money, not the larger army
tuples.evidence_lens: pay records for the final months read with eyewitness accounts of the surrender

tuples.episode_object: a frontier commander's letter requesting outside assistance
tuples.mechanism: inviting a foreign army through a wall to beat a rebel hands it the road to the capital
tuples.evidence_lens: correspondence preserved in both court archives compared for dates and sequence

tuples.episode_object: an enthronement announcement issued by a southern court
tuples.mechanism: several princes with equal claims and separate armies cannot combine and fall in turn
tuples.evidence_lens: the rival proclamations dated and mapped against the campaigns that ended them

tuples.episode_object: a city's defence roster and grain store account
tuples.mechanism: making an example of one canal city shortens the campaign for every city downstream
tuples.evidence_lens: gazetteers and private accounts compared for population, all figures treated as contested

tuples.episode_object: an edict requiring men to adopt a prescribed hairstyle
tuples.mechanism: a visible mark of submission forces a public choice and turns indifference into a side
tuples.evidence_lens: gazetteers compared for the order's arrival date and the resistance that followed

tuples.episode_object: a registered population count taken after the fighting
tuples.mechanism: a province fought over by several armies loses its registers and must be resettled first
tuples.evidence_lens: registered figures before and after read as tax categories, not as head counts

tuples.episode_object: a letter carried by an envoy seeking foreign help
tuples.time_place_scope: the southwest and the last claimant court, 1647-1662
tuples.mechanism: a court retreating past its own supply base becomes the property of its escorting generals
tuples.evidence_lens: surviving court correspondence read with the itineraries of the retreat

tuples.episode_object: a merchant fleet's account of shipping licences and tolls
tuples.mechanism: a body funded by its own trade outlasts a land regime because it needs no territory
tuples.evidence_lens: the family's trading accounts compared with Dutch and Japanese port records

tuples.episode_object: articles of capitulation signed at a coastal fort
tuples.mechanism: an offshore base gives a defeated cause a territory to tax and a harbour to refit in
tuples.evidence_lens: the company's surrender documents compared with Chinese accounts of the siege

tuples.episode_object: a boundary marker for a depopulated coastal strip
tuples.mechanism: clearing a coast of people denies a sea power suppliers at the cost of coastal revenue
tuples.evidence_lens: the evacuation line traced from gazetteers and confirmed by abandoned settlements

tuples.episode_object: a property allocation list for houses in a walled inner city
tuples.mechanism: settling a conquering army inside the capital keeps it available and keeps it separate
tuples.evidence_lens: allocation records compared with the surviving street plan and later residence surveys

tuples.episode_object: a graduation list posted after a provincial examination
tuples.mechanism: reopening examinations quickly gives local elites careers requiring the new house to last
tuples.evidence_lens: graduation lists compared by province and year for how fast candidates returned

tuples.episode_object: a subsidy account for maintaining a semi-autonomous army
tuples.mechanism: paying regional commanders to hold a frontier breeds armies loyal to their paymasters
tuples.evidence_lens: central subsidy figures compared with the cost of the war fought to end them

tuples.episode_object: a naval order of battle listing squadrons and gun counts
tuples.mechanism: a state that builds its own fleet can finally reach the island base blockade could not
tuples.evidence_lens: fleet lists on both sides compared with the campaign's recorded engagements

tuples.episode_object: a compilation draft of a fallen dynasty's official history
tuples.time_place_scope: the capital's history office, the 1670s to 1700s
tuples.mechanism: writing a predecessor's history employs its scholars and settles what the change will mean
tuples.evidence_lens: successive drafts of the history compared for what changed between them

tuples.episode_object: a judgment upholding a royal power to dispense with statute
tuples.mechanism: a bench remade until it rules for the crown becomes an argument for resistance
tuples.evidence_lens: the reported judgment read with the record of judicial removals just before it

tuples.episode_object: an encampment return of regiments and their officers
tuples.mechanism: a standing camp within sight of a capital reads as coercion whatever its purpose
tuples.evidence_lens: army lists compared year by year for the religion and origin of new officers

tuples.episode_object: a college minute of a disputed election to a headship
tuples.mechanism: overriding a corporation's own statutes shows every other that its charter is worthless
tuples.evidence_lens: college registers compared with the commission's proceedings against the fellows

tuples.episode_object: a surrendered borough charter and the replacement issued for it
tuples.mechanism: remodelling town corporations to fix a future election makes elections look manageable
tuples.evidence_lens: charter surrenders and nominations counted borough by borough against later returns

tuples.episode_object: a petition from senior clergy declining to publish a royal declaration
tuples.mechanism: prosecuting a respectful refusal turns loyal churchmen into a lawful opposition with juries
tuples.evidence_lens: the trial record compared with the printed petitions circulating those same weeks

tuples.episode_object: a register entry recording a royal birth and its witnesses
tuples.mechanism: an heir raised in the ruler's faith makes a temporary problem into a permanent one
tuples.evidence_lens: depositions later taken about the birth read against the rumours they answered

tuples.episode_object: a fleet's victualling and transport charter list
tuples.mechanism: an invasion needing another assembly to vote its money cannot be prepared in secret
tuples.evidence_lens: admiralty and states' resolutions compared with the shipping actually chartered

tuples.episode_object: a printed declaration distributed at a landing
tuples.time_place_scope: Torbay and the Devon coast, November 1688
tuples.mechanism: landing with a manifesto promising a free parliament frames invasion as appeal to law
tuples.evidence_lens: surviving printings compared for variants and for where copies actually circulated

tuples.episode_object: an officer's letter announcing his desertion to the other side
tuples.time_place_scope: Salisbury and the west road, November 1688
tuples.mechanism: an army whose officers defect one by one dissolves and leaves nothing to bargain with
tuples.evidence_lens: regimental records and dated defection letters compared with the marching orders

tuples.episode_object: a provisional council's order to keep the peace
tuples.time_place_scope: London in the weeks without a government, December 1688
tuples.mechanism: a short interval with no acknowledged sovereign lets peers become the summoning body
tuples.evidence_lens: the provisional orders compared with the city's own records of disorder those days

tuples.episode_object: a declaration of rights read before an offer of the crown
tuples.mechanism: reciting grievances just before offering a throne makes conditions part of the transaction
tuples.evidence_lens: the declaration compared clause by clause with the statute enacted later that year

tuples.episode_object: a claim of right drawn up by a northern convention
tuples.mechanism: a separate kingdom settling its own crown produces a different bargain from one event
tuples.evidence_lens: the two kingdoms' settlement documents compared for what each says about forfeiture

tuples.episode_object: an oath of allegiance certified before a sheriff by a stated date
tuples.mechanism: making submission dated paperwork lets an administration read a missed deadline as licence
tuples.evidence_lens: the surviving certificates and their dates read with the later official inquiry

tuples.episode_object: a siege garrison's ration book
tuples.mechanism: a walled port relievable by sea ties down an army that has no fleet to close it
tuples.evidence_lens: garrison accounts compared with the logs of the relieving squadron

tuples.episode_object: a river crossing plan with the fords marked
tuples.mechanism: forcing a river line with a better-supplied army decides a campaign without destroying one
tuples.evidence_lens: contemporary maps of the fords compared with accounts of where each corps crossed

tuples.episode_object: articles of surrender permitting a garrison to sail abroad
tuples.mechanism: letting a beaten army leave for foreign service ends a war and creates an exile force
tuples.evidence_lens: the articles compared with numbers recorded embarking and their later regimental rolls

tuples.episode_object: an estimate laid before parliament for a season's forces
tuples.mechanism: annual votes for an army abroad make the assembly's yearly meeting unavoidable
tuples.evidence_lens: annual supply estimates and session lengths compared across the war years

tuples.episode_object: a subscription book for a loan exchanged for a corporate charter
tuples.mechanism: lending through a chartered corporation gives creditors an institution outliving a ruler
tuples.evidence_lens: subscription lists compared with government borrowing rates before and after

tuples.episode_object: an assay report on clipped and worn silver coin
tuples.mechanism: recoining to a fixed standard in wartime chooses monetary credit over convenience
tuples.evidence_lens: mint output records and coin hoards from the years either side of the recoinage

tuples.episode_object: an act limiting the descent of a crown and the tenure of judges
tuples.mechanism: settling a distant succession by statute makes the assembly, not descent, decide
tuples.evidence_lens: the successive acts compared for conditions added each time the question reopened

coverage_profiles.subject: the formation of the Asante empire

tuples.episode_object: an excavated cache of iron tools and imported beads at a forest site
tuples.time_place_scope: the Pra and Offin forest country, the seventeenth century
tuples.mechanism: clearing forest for food lets population gather where gold and kola are, not good farmland
tuples.evidence_lens: settlement sequences dated by imported goods and compared across the forest zone

tuples.episode_object: a tribute schedule of gold dust owed by a subject chiefdom
tuples.mechanism: tribute in gold dust from the people who mine it grows demands and resentment together
tuples.evidence_lens: oral traditions of tribute compared with coastal traders' notes on inland gold supply

tuples.episode_object: a captured state umbrella and set of drums taken as spoils
tuples.mechanism: capturing a paramount's regalia transfers the visible right to command allied chiefs
tuples.evidence_lens: regalia later held in royal treasuries traced against traditions of their capture

tuples.episode_object: a stool held in trust for a union of chiefdoms
tuples.mechanism: one object no chief may own but all must acknowledge outlives each ruler's death
tuples.evidence_lens: founding traditions compared across member chiefdoms for what each of them claims

tuples.episode_object: a company note recording ground rent paid for a coastal fort
tuples.time_place_scope: Elmina castle and its rent rolls, from 1701
tuples.mechanism: taking over a fort's ground rent transfers a recognised income and recognised standing
tuples.evidence_lens: company ledgers of rent payments compared with the inland power they name

tuples.episode_object: an inventory of captured brass vessels and gold ornament
tuples.time_place_scope: the Bono country north of the forest, 1722-1723
tuples.mechanism: seizing northern market towns puts a forest state astride the routes to the desert trade
tuples.evidence_lens: traditions of the campaign compared with interruptions in northern market chronicles

tuples.episode_object: a levy roll of contingents owed by allied chiefdoms
tuples.mechanism: an army raised as quotas costs the centre nothing until it marches and binds each member
tuples.evidence_lens: contingent obligations in oral tradition compared with forces European observers counted

tuples.episode_object: an annual tribute account rendered in captives and cloth
tuples.mechanism: tribute taken in people supplies both the coastal trade and labour for the goldfields
tuples.evidence_lens: northern court chronicles compared with export series recorded at the coastal forts

tuples.episode_object: an Arabic chronicle kept by a savanna court
tuples.time_place_scope: Gonja and the Volta trade routes, the mid eighteenth century
tuples.mechanism: a literate neighbour writes down what a forest state recites, giving two dating frames
tuples.evidence_lens: the Arabic chronicles collated with forest oral tradition for events both describe

tuples.episode_object: a boundary oath sworn between two neighbouring chiefdoms
tuples.time_place_scope: Gyaaman and the western border, the 1740s
tuples.mechanism: settling a frontier by oath saves troops but leaves it retested at every succession
tuples.evidence_lens: successive traditions of the same boundary compared for how the line is described

tuples.episode_object: a road warden's toll and passage record
tuples.time_place_scope: the great roads out of Kumasi, the eighteenth century
tuples.mechanism: measured roads from one capital let the centre time messengers and audit its provinces
tuples.evidence_lens: road distances in travellers' accounts compared with routes traced on the ground

tuples.episode_object: an appointment warrant for an office not held by inheritance
tuples.mechanism: offices filled by appointment rather than lineage give a ruler servants who depend on him
tuples.evidence_lens: officeholder lists from tradition compared with the lineage stools that predate them

tuples.episode_object: a written charm and an accompanying letter in Arabic
tuples.time_place_scope: the Muslim quarter of the capital, the later eighteenth century
tuples.mechanism: employing literate northerners as scribes buys records and diplomacy without their faith
tuples.evidence_lens: surviving Arabic manuscripts from the capital compared with descriptions of the writers

tuples.episode_object: a set of brass weights used to measure gold dust
tuples.time_place_scope: the Akan goldfields, the eighteenth century
tuples.mechanism: a shared weight standard lets gold dust serve as money without anyone minting a coin
tuples.evidence_lens: surviving weight sets measured for standard and compared across regions and periods

tuples.episode_object: a fort daybook recording inland caravans and their goods
tuples.time_place_scope: the European forts of the Gold Coast, the eighteenth century
tuples.mechanism: forts that can neither move nor feed themselves leave terms to their inland suppliers
tuples.evidence_lens: fort daybooks read as a trading post's record, not as the interior they describe

tuples.episode_object: a treaty draft between a European governor and an inland envoy
tuples.time_place_scope: the Fante towns of the littoral, 1807
tuples.mechanism: an inland power reaching the shore can deal with Europeans and cut out the middlemen
tuples.evidence_lens: governors' despatches from the coastal forts compared with traditions of the campaign

tuples.episode_object: a published mission account with a drawn plan of a capital
tuples.mechanism: a resident embassy yields the first outside account of a court's revenue and army
tuples.evidence_lens: the published account read as one visitor's report, checked against later visits

tuples.episode_object: a field despatch reporting the loss of a colonial detachment
tuples.mechanism: a force fighting beyond its ammunition can be destroyed by an army it called irregular
tuples.evidence_lens: the surviving despatches compared with later inquiries into ammunition supply

tuples.episode_object: an allied order of battle listing coastal contingents and rockets
tuples.mechanism: massed allied firepower on open ground reverses an advantage that held in forest fighting
tuples.evidence_lens: battle returns from the allied side compared with traditions preserved inland

tuples.episode_object: a treaty depositing hostages and a sum of gold as security
tuples.mechanism: a peace secured by hostages and a deposit replaces an occupation neither side can afford
tuples.evidence_lens: the treaty text compared with the record of whether deposit and hostages returned

tuples.episode_object: a fort commandant's garrison and grain-store inventory
tuples.time_place_scope: the Konkan ghats and the hill forts, the 1660s and 1670s
tuples.mechanism: many provisioned hill forts make an occupier spend a year taking what a raider retakes
tuples.evidence_lens: fort inventories compared with siege durations recorded in imperial campaign diaries

tuples.episode_object: a coronation account of gifts, weights of gold and attending priests
tuples.mechanism: an enthronement with priestly rites turns a successful commander into a granting sovereign
tuples.evidence_lens: coronation accounts compared with the titles used in documents before and after

tuples.episode_object: a campaign diary of an imperial camp on permanent march
tuples.mechanism: an empire that moves its whole court to chase a mobile enemy pays twice for one war
tuples.evidence_lens: the camp's daily records compared with revenue the provinces remitted meanwhile

tuples.episode_object: a grant of revenue rights issued from inside a besieged fortress
tuples.mechanism: a court still issuing valid grants under siege ties its officers' fortunes to its survival
tuples.evidence_lens: grants dated during the siege years compared with the districts they assign

tuples.episode_object: a rival claimant's seal on a competing revenue order
tuples.mechanism: two courts claiming one district make collectors choose, and the payer becomes the state
tuples.evidence_lens: the two courts' surviving orders compared for districts each could actually collect

tuples.episode_object: an imperial grant conceding a share of provincial revenue
tuples.mechanism: a legal right to a share of another state's revenue turns raiding into lawful collection
tuples.evidence_lens: the grant's terms compared with sums actually remitted over the following decade

tuples.episode_object: a chief minister's seal and the register of orders issued under it
tuples.mechanism: when the executive office becomes hereditary, the throne's authority is exercised elsewhere
tuples.evidence_lens: outgoing order registers compared for whose seal authorises what, year by year

tuples.episode_object: a route book of fords and stages across a river barrier
tuples.time_place_scope: Malwa and the Narmada crossings, the 1720s and 1730s
tuples.mechanism: cavalry that outmarches its opponents appears behind them and turns their supply line
tuples.evidence_lens: campaign route books compared with marching rates recorded for opposing armies

tuples.episode_object: a farming contract for a district's collection at a fixed sum
tuples.time_place_scope: Gujarat and the Cambay revenues, the 1730s
tuples.mechanism: farming collection to captains who owe a fixed sum makes conquest pay for its own next step
tuples.evidence_lens: farm contracts compared with the arrears recorded against the same holders

tuples.episode_object: a siege journal of a coastal fortress and its mine chambers
tuples.mechanism: taking a European fortified port removes a rival customs authority from a held coast
tuples.evidence_lens: besiegers' and defenders' journals compared, with the surviving works surveyed

tuples.episode_object: a pass sold to a merchant ship for safe passage
tuples.time_place_scope: the western coast and its fleets, 1700-1756
tuples.mechanism: selling protection passes turns naval strength into revenue paid by rivals' shipping
tuples.evidence_lens: pass records and company complaints compared with the fleet's recorded captures

tuples.episode_object: a receipt for a negotiated annual payment from a provincial government
tuples.time_place_scope: Nagpur and the eastern marches, the 1740s
tuples.mechanism: payments bought to prevent raids formalise an exaction and push the payer to arm
tuples.evidence_lens: payment receipts compared with raiding seasons in eastern provincial chronicles

tuples.episode_object: a commissariat return for an army encamped far from its base
tuples.mechanism: an army a thousand miles from its revenue loses to whoever cuts its grain first
tuples.evidence_lens: supply and forage records compared with how long the encampment lasted before battle

tuples.episode_object: a bundle of daily accounts filed by department
tuples.time_place_scope: Pune's record office, the mid eighteenth century
tuples.mechanism: keeping every order and account in one archive lets a ministry supervise unseen commanders
tuples.evidence_lens: surviving departmental bundles sampled for what was recorded and what was not

tuples.episode_object: a contract engaging a European officer to drill infantry
tuples.time_place_scope: Gwalior and the northern brigades, the 1780s
tuples.mechanism: buying drilled infantry and cast guns supplies what light cavalry cannot, at heavy cost
tuples.evidence_lens: brigade pay accounts compared with the districts assigned to fund them

tuples.episode_object: an imperial edict issued under a protector's guarantee
tuples.mechanism: holding a powerless emperor lets a regional power issue claims rivals still recognise
tuples.evidence_lens: edicts of these years compared for who drafted, sealed and enforced them

tuples.episode_object: a division agreement splitting a district's revenue between two claimants
tuples.time_place_scope: Baroda and the western districts, the later eighteenth century
tuples.mechanism: shared revenue districts create joint interests and a standing invitation to arbitrate
tuples.evidence_lens: division agreements compared with disputes later taken to an outside power

tuples.episode_object: a collector's tour itinerary with sums assessed on each chief
tuples.mechanism: an armed annual tour that collects then withdraws taxes a region without governing it
tuples.evidence_lens: tour itineraries and totals compared across successive years for one circuit

tuples.episode_object: a ratified treaty restoring territories after a war
tuples.mechanism: returning conquests while conceding recognition ends a war and leaves claims reopenable
tuples.evidence_lens: the ratified text compared with the territorial position when fighting stopped

tuples.episode_object: a subsidiary alliance requiring a state to fund troops it cannot command
tuples.mechanism: making a state pay for garrisons under another's orders hollows it before any battle
tuples.evidence_lens: alliance treaties compared with each state's revenue and its later loss of land

coverage_profiles.subject: the Qing conquest of the Zunghar state

tuples.episode_object: a herding household's registration under an Oirat lord
tuples.time_place_scope: the Ili valley, the later seventeenth century
tuples.mechanism: a pastoral state that registers its herders can raise cavalry without asking each clan
tuples.evidence_lens: envoys' reports on Oirat organisation compared with survey of the valley's sites

tuples.episode_object: a petition for refuge submitted by displaced princes
tuples.mechanism: refugees asking a neighbour for protection bring their pastures if he can restore them
tuples.evidence_lens: the petitions kept in the Qing archives compared with Mongol chronicles of the flight

tuples.episode_object: a battle report describing a camel and wagon laager under fire
tuples.mechanism: field artillery breaks a line of tied camels that steppe cavalry could not have broken
tuples.evidence_lens: campaign reports compared with the ordnance inventories of the units engaged

tuples.episode_object: an assembly record listing princes and the ranks conferred on them
tuples.mechanism: enrolling nobles in a graded order with fixed pastures ends the mobility that made them
tuples.evidence_lens: enrolment lists compared with the banner boundaries later mapped on those pastures

tuples.episode_object: a supply plan for grain depots along a desert march
tuples.mechanism: grain placed across a desert in advance lets a settled army stay out long enough to catch
tuples.evidence_lens: depot placements rebuilt from campaign memorials and matched to routes marched

tuples.episode_object: an after-action memorial listing captured herds and families
tuples.time_place_scope: Jao Modo near the Tuul river, 1696
tuples.mechanism: destroying herds and dependants ends a nomadic army even when most of its men escape
tuples.evidence_lens: capture returns compared with later reports of the same leader's strength

tuples.episode_object: a boundary treaty drafted in several languages with interpreters
tuples.mechanism: fixing a border with one great neighbour frees an empire to concentrate on the other
tuples.evidence_lens: the treaty's parallel texts compared for what each language version concedes

tuples.episode_object: a caravan permit for a fixed number of merchants
tuples.mechanism: licensed frontier trade gives a neighbour a stake in the border staying shut to others
tuples.evidence_lens: caravan permits and customs records compared with trade volumes before regulation

tuples.episode_object: a seal of investiture presented to an enthroned religious leader
tuples.mechanism: whoever installs a recognised hierarch inherits the loyalty of everyone who follows him
tuples.evidence_lens: Tibetan and Qing records compared for who is said to have chosen the candidate

tuples.episode_object: a register of monasteries with their permitted numbers of monks
tuples.mechanism: capping monastic numbers removes the manpower and granaries a regional rising would use
tuples.evidence_lens: monastery registers before and after the settlement compared with later records

tuples.episode_object: a demarcation agreement naming rivers and mountain passes
tuples.mechanism: an agreed frontier after an indecisive war lets both demobilise while conceding nothing
tuples.evidence_lens: the named landmarks located on the ground and compared with later boundary practice

tuples.episode_object: a relay station's roster of horses, drivers and rations
tuples.time_place_scope: the Mongolian post roads, the eighteenth century
tuples.mechanism: manned relay stations turn empty steppe into a corridor for armies and for orders
tuples.evidence_lens: station rosters compared with recorded transit times of despatches on that route

tuples.episode_object: a military colony's harvest return
tuples.time_place_scope: Barkol and the Hami depots, the 1720s to 1750s
tuples.mechanism: soldiers growing grain at the frontier cut the haulage cost that made deep war unaffordable
tuples.evidence_lens: colony harvest returns compared with the cost of grain hauled from interior provinces

tuples.episode_object: a defector's deposition taken at a frontier post
tuples.time_place_scope: the Zunghar heartland during the succession quarrels, 1745-1754
tuples.mechanism: a contested succession sends losing claimants abroad, each with intelligence and a claim
tuples.evidence_lens: frontier depositions compared with later accounts of the same factional disputes

tuples.episode_object: a campaign map marking the routes of two converging columns
tuples.mechanism: two columns from separate depots stop a mobile enemy concentrating against either one
tuples.evidence_lens: campaign maps compared with memorials reporting each column's daily positions

tuples.episode_object: a pacification report listing surrendered and dispersed households
tuples.time_place_scope: the northern steppe of the Tianshan, 1756-1757
tuples.mechanism: a revolt by a leader the invaders installed turns occupation into war on the population
tuples.evidence_lens: population figures in campaign reports treated as contested and set against resettlement

tuples.episode_object: a grain requisition receipt issued to an oasis town
tuples.mechanism: an army fed from oases makes requisition the first thing the conquered actually meet
tuples.evidence_lens: requisition records compared with assessed grain output in later oasis surveys

tuples.episode_object: a walled garrison town's foundation plan with its granary
tuples.time_place_scope: the new garrison towns beyond the passes, the 1760s
tuples.mechanism: garrison towns with their own farms make a distant conquest cost less every year
tuples.evidence_lens: the town plans compared with excavated remains and with annual supply accounts

tuples.episode_object: a transfer order relocating banner families across the empire
tuples.mechanism: moving frontier soldiers with their families makes a garrison reproduce instead of rotate
tuples.evidence_lens: transfer orders compared with descendant communities recorded in later censuses

tuples.episode_object: a migration account of a nomadic people leaving one empire for another
tuples.mechanism: an emptied grassland draws another nomadic group in on the new pasture owner's terms
tuples.evidence_lens: Russian and Qing records of the migration compared for numbers, which differ widely

coverage_profiles.subject: the decline of the Mughal empire

tuples.episode_object: a mansab rank appointment issued under the imperial seal
tuples.mechanism: ranking officers by cavalry quotas paid from assigned land ties rank to land still held
tuples.evidence_lens: rank lists in court histories set against assignable revenue in administrative manuals

tuples.episode_object: an assignment paper transferring a district's revenue to an officer
tuples.time_place_scope: the Ganges-Jamuna doab, early eighteenth century
tuples.mechanism: promising more land income than exists leaves every new assignment short before collection
tuples.evidence_lens: counts of assignments issued against surveyed revenue totals for those provinces

tuples.episode_object: a court newsletter carried from the palace to a provincial governor
tuples.mechanism: frequent changes of ruler let provincial officers wait out orders instead of obeying
tuples.evidence_lens: dated newsletters checked against when orders were actually executed in the provinces

tuples.episode_object: a treasury inventory drawn up after a sack of the capital
tuples.mechanism: removing hoarded bullion destroys the credit that cavalry pay and contracts depend on
tuples.evidence_lens: mint output before and after, read with merchant banking correspondence of the decade

tuples.episode_object: a protection-payment receipt for a quarter of assessed revenue
tuples.mechanism: conceding a fixed revenue share to a rival funds his army without a battle
tuples.evidence_lens: registers kept by the receiving power beside the imperial assessment for those districts

tuples.episode_object: a bill of exchange drawn on a banking house in favour of a governor
tuples.mechanism: financiers lending to a governor and his challenger alike make the outcome fiscally neutral
tuples.evidence_lens: surviving firm papers matched against the political changes they financed

tuples.episode_object: a trading privilege granted under imperial order to a European company
tuples.mechanism: exempting one merchant group from inland duties makes the customs line unenforceable
tuples.evidence_lens: port duty receipts before and after the exemption, set beside company import books

tuples.episode_object: a hereditary governor's tribute remittance record
tuples.time_place_scope: the Deccan under its own governor, from 1724
tuples.mechanism: a governor who remits tribute but refuses transfer leaves the centre a name, not a lever
tuples.evidence_lens: remittance entries in central accounts beside the record of transfer orders ignored

tuples.episode_object: a coin struck at a provincial mint in the emperor's name
tuples.time_place_scope: the Punjab mints, mid eighteenth century
tuples.mechanism: when a name on coin outlives orders, rivals compete to hold the sovereign, not replace him
