tuples.evidence_lens: the chronicle's claims tested against independent accounts and administrative papers

tuples.episode_object: a grain tithe assessment recorded for a district
tuples.time_place_scope: the emirates of the Hausa plains, 1820s
tuples.mechanism: taxing harvest by a legal share rather than custom makes assessment a religious act too
tuples.evidence_lens: assessment records compared with the legal texts the assessors cited

tuples.episode_object: a fortified frontier settlement's garrison roster
tuples.mechanism: planting garrisons on a raiding border turns an open frontier into a line that can be taxed
tuples.evidence_lens: settlement sites surveyed against tribute records of the districts behind them

tuples.episode_object: a dyepit and cloth market toll record
tuples.mechanism: taxing a manufacturing city's trade lets a ruler pay officials in cash rather than land
tuples.evidence_lens: market toll records compared with salaries recorded for administrative officeholders

tuples.episode_object: a caravan's customs payment noted at a Saharan entrepot
tuples.time_place_scope: the routes north from Kano to the Fezzan, 1820s-1870s
tuples.mechanism: long-distance trade in cloth and leather ties inland revenue to markets it cannot control
tuples.evidence_lens: entrepot records compared with North African port customs for the same goods

tuples.episode_object: an estate labour record from a settlement worked by captives
tuples.time_place_scope: the grain-producing districts of the emirates, the nineteenth century
tuples.mechanism: settling captives on estates converts raiding into a standing food supply for armies
tuples.evidence_lens: estate sites and records compared with the provisioning needs of nearby garrisons

tuples.episode_object: a tribute inventory listing horses, cloth and cowries
tuples.time_place_scope: the emirates remitting to the caliphal capital, 1820s-1890s
tuples.mechanism: annual tribute in goods keeps subordinates self-administering but visibly subordinate
tuples.evidence_lens: tribute lists compared over decades for what each emirate sent and when it lapsed

tuples.episode_object: a poem written in a local language using Arabic script
tuples.time_place_scope: the Fulfulde and Hausa speaking districts, the nineteenth century
tuples.mechanism: putting doctrine into vernacular verse spreads a legal argument beyond readers of Arabic
tuples.evidence_lens: surviving manuscript copies counted by language and by where they were collected

tuples.episode_object: a land grant confirming a scholarly family's holdings
tuples.time_place_scope: the districts around the caliphal capital, mid nineteenth century
tuples.mechanism: endowing the scholars who justified a conquest makes learning a hereditary landed interest
tuples.evidence_lens: grant documents traced through the same families' later officeholding

tuples.episode_object: a European traveller's route journal with daily stages
tuples.mechanism: an outsider recording distances and markets leaves a check on figures no local source gives
tuples.evidence_lens: journal stage distances and market notes compared with chronicles and later surveys

tuples.episode_object: a mosque and school foundation record in a provincial town
tuples.mechanism: founding schools in conquered towns replaces one legal establishment with another
tuples.evidence_lens: foundation records compared with the judicial appointments made in those towns

tuples.episode_object: an inventory of cavalry mail, horses and quilted armour
tuples.time_place_scope: the emirate armies, the nineteenth century
tuples.mechanism: an army built on imported horses and armour must keep its resupply routes open
tuples.evidence_lens: equipment inventories compared with horse import records along the desert routes

tuples.episode_object: a colonial intelligence report describing emirate boundaries
tuples.mechanism: an invader who maps an existing administration can choose to keep it rather than replace it
tuples.evidence_lens: intelligence reports compared with the residencies established after the conquest

tuples.episode_object: a treaty signed between an emir and an occupying administration
tuples.mechanism: confirming rulers in exchange for taxes preserves an older geography inside a new empire
tuples.evidence_lens: treaty terms compared with tax remittance records under the new administration

tuples.episode_object: a manuscript library catalogue compiled by a family custodian
tuples.time_place_scope: the collections of northern Nigeria, the twentieth century
tuples.mechanism: what survives in private libraries decides which arguments later historians can read at all
tuples.evidence_lens: catalogues compared across collections to see which texts survive in many copies

tuples.episode_object: a merchant brig's registration and ownership share document
tuples.mechanism: shipping profits held in shares spread capital widely, so a fleet can be raised privately
tuples.evidence_lens: ship registers compared with the vessels listed in the insurgent squadrons

tuples.episode_object: a marine insurance policy on a grain cargo
tuples.time_place_scope: the Black Sea grain trade to the Mediterranean, 1800s-1810s
tuples.mechanism: carrying another empire's grain under a neutral flag builds crews and capital to redirect
tuples.evidence_lens: insurance and freight records compared with later crew lists from the same islands

tuples.episode_object: an initiation oath document of a conspiratorial society
tuples.time_place_scope: Odessa and the Black Sea ports, 1814-1820
tuples.mechanism: a secret society among merchants abroad funds a rising without exposing anyone at home
tuples.evidence_lens: membership records compared with the remittances traced to the ports involved

tuples.episode_object: a commission appointing a Christian captain to guard a pass
tuples.mechanism: employing armed Christian bands to police passes trains the officers a rising will use
tuples.evidence_lens: Ottoman appointment records compared with commanders named in insurgent accounts

tuples.episode_object: an Ottoman district tax register captured by insurgents
tuples.mechanism: seizing tax registers lets a new authority collect at once from an assessment it did not build
tuples.evidence_lens: captured registers compared with the first demands issued by the provisional authority

tuples.episode_object: a proclamation issued on crossing a river into a principality
tuples.mechanism: starting a rising where foreign help is assumed fails once that help is publicly disowned
tuples.evidence_lens: the proclamation compared with the diplomatic disavowals published within weeks

tuples.episode_object: a provisional assembly's constitutional text
tuples.mechanism: writing a constitution early gives a rising a government foreign powers can negotiate with
tuples.evidence_lens: the text compared with recognitions and refusals it drew from European chancelleries

tuples.episode_object: a refugee relief committee's registration list
tuples.mechanism: the displaced who reach foreign ports become the evidence on which outside opinion forms
tuples.evidence_lens: relief lists compared with the newspaper accounts published in the same cities

tuples.episode_object: a fire-ship expedition's expense and crew account
tuples.mechanism: cheap incendiary attacks make a large fleet cautious and keep sea lanes open to the weaker
tuples.evidence_lens: expedition accounts compared with movements recorded in the opposing fleet's logs

tuples.episode_object: a loan prospectus offered to subscribers in a foreign capital
tuples.mechanism: lending to a government that does not yet exist prices the loan for default from the start
tuples.evidence_lens: subscription and disbursement records compared with what reached the fighting forces

tuples.episode_object: a supply contract for an expeditionary force sent by sea
tuples.time_place_scope: the Morea under the Egyptian expedition, 1825-1827
tuples.mechanism: an intervening army with a modern supply chain holds ground irregulars had made ungovernable
tuples.evidence_lens: contract records compared with the districts reported pacified each season

tuples.episode_object: a siege engineer's plan of a lagoon town's defences
tuples.mechanism: a besieged town supplied across shallow water holds until the besieger controls the shallows
tuples.evidence_lens: siege plans compared with naval records of the blockading and relieving vessels

tuples.episode_object: a fleet action report from a bay engagement
tuples.mechanism: destroying transport capacity in harbour ends a land campaign that needs reinforcement by sea
tuples.evidence_lens: the action reports compared with the expeditionary army's later evacuation records

tuples.episode_object: a protocol signed by three powers defining a new state's status
tuples.mechanism: guarantees settle borders in chancelleries, so a state's shape follows diplomacy not battle
tuples.evidence_lens: successive protocol texts compared with the territory actually held at each date

tuples.episode_object: a treaty article ending a war between two empires
tuples.mechanism: a separate war between larger powers can settle a small conflict as one clause among many
tuples.evidence_lens: the treaty's Greek clauses compared with the concurrent negotiations in London

tuples.episode_object: an inventory of estates declared public land
tuples.mechanism: turning confiscated estates into national land lets a poor state pay in land and defer tenure
tuples.evidence_lens: national land inventories compared with distribution records of later decades

tuples.episode_object: a governor's circular reorganising local administration
tuples.mechanism: imposing appointed officials on captains who fought turns allies into rivals for office
tuples.evidence_lens: appointment circulars compared with factional violence recorded in those districts

tuples.episode_object: a regency budget listing salaries and loan service
tuples.time_place_scope: the new kingdom under a foreign regency, 1833-1835
tuples.mechanism: a guaranteed loan spent on administration and debt leaves nothing for the countryside taxed
tuples.evidence_lens: budget lines compared with agricultural tax arrears reported in the same years

tuples.episode_object: a prosecution file for banditry in a border district
tuples.time_place_scope: the northern frontier of the kingdom, 1830s-1840s
tuples.mechanism: a frontier leaving populations outside a new state keeps armed movement across it profitable
tuples.evidence_lens: prosecution files mapped against the border line fixed by the powers

tuples.episode_object: a village tax apportionment agreement signed by elders
tuples.mechanism: collecting through village notables preserves the old order's intermediaries under new names
tuples.evidence_lens: apportionment agreements compared with Ottoman-era records for the same villages

tuples.episode_object: a transcript of oral testimony taken from elderly informants
tuples.mechanism: testimony recorded decades later passes through the interests of speaker and collector alike
tuples.evidence_lens: the same episodes compared across informants and against the questions they were asked

tuples.episode_object: a praise poem written down by a collector
tuples.time_place_scope: the Zulu-speaking districts, the nineteenth and twentieth centuries
tuples.mechanism: praise verse preserves names and claims in performance but is composed to honour, not to date
tuples.evidence_lens: recorded versions compared for what changes and what holds between performances

tuples.episode_object: a trader's journal kept at a small coastal settlement
tuples.mechanism: a resident trader seeking land has reason to describe his host as a ruler able to grant it
tuples.evidence_lens: the journals compared with the published books made from them years afterwards

tuples.episode_object: a document claiming a grant of land at a bay
tuples.mechanism: a cession recorded by one party proves what that party wanted recognised, not what was agreed
tuples.evidence_lens: the claim's wording compared with later colonial adjudications of the same ground

tuples.episode_object: a Portuguese customs record of ivory shipped from a bay
tuples.mechanism: controlling a coastal market lets one polity turn hunting output into goods it redistributes
tuples.evidence_lens: export volumes by year compared with political changes reported in the interior

tuples.episode_object: an excavated cattle enclosure at a large homestead site
tuples.time_place_scope: the Thukela and Mfolozi valleys, before 1830
tuples.mechanism: a central herd lent out to followers makes their wealth depend on continuing favour
tuples.evidence_lens: enclosure sizes and dung deposits compared across sites of differing status

tuples.episode_object: a ground plan of a large homestead recorded by survey
tuples.time_place_scope: the Zulu heartland, the early nineteenth century
tuples.mechanism: quartering unmarried men at royal homesteads puts labour and marriage under one authority
tuples.evidence_lens: settlement plans compared with the age and sex composition the layout implies

tuples.episode_object: an iron smelting furnace base uncovered in excavation
tuples.time_place_scope: the Natal interior, the eighteenth and nineteenth centuries
tuples.mechanism: concentrating metal production means hoes and weapons share one production bottleneck
tuples.evidence_lens: slag volumes and furnace dates compared with the spread of iron goods on sites

tuples.episode_object: a grinding stone and grain pit assemblage from a settlement layer
tuples.time_place_scope: the Natal midlands, the eighteenth century
tuples.mechanism: storable grain surplus decides how long a polity can keep men away from their own fields
tuples.evidence_lens: storage pit capacities compared across sites and periods within one river system

tuples.episode_object: a tree-ring or pollen sequence used as a climate proxy
tuples.time_place_scope: south-eastern Africa, around the turn of the nineteenth century
tuples.mechanism: a run of dry years pushes herders and cultivators into competition for well-watered ground
tuples.evidence_lens: proxy sequences compared with dated events reported in oral and written sources

tuples.episode_object: a missionary station diary recording arrivals and conversations
tuples.mechanism: a mission record fixes accounts of an earlier reign given by people with their own reasons
tuples.evidence_lens: diary entries compared with what the same informants told later collectors

tuples.episode_object: a colonial map marking districts as unoccupied
tuples.time_place_scope: the interior of southern Africa, the 1830s-1850s
tuples.mechanism: describing land as emptied by African violence supplies a settlement claim that needs checking
tuples.evidence_lens: map annotations compared with archaeological evidence of occupation in those districts

tuples.episode_object: an inventory of cattle taken in a later punitive campaign
tuples.mechanism: cattle seizure works as war because herds are both currency and political tie in one
tuples.evidence_lens: seizure inventories compared with herd counts recorded before the campaign

tuples.episode_object: a genealogical chart compiled by a colonial official
tuples.time_place_scope: the colony of Natal, the later nineteenth century
tuples.mechanism: recording succession as a single line makes contested claims look settled and simplifies rule
tuples.evidence_lens: official genealogies compared with competing versions given by different lineages

tuples.episode_object: a homestead census return from a colonial location
tuples.mechanism: counting homesteads for tax fixes households in categories the earlier polity never used
tuples.evidence_lens: census categories compared with settlement patterns visible archaeologically

tuples.episode_object: a newspaper report from a distant colonial port
tuples.mechanism: distant reporting repeats traders' accounts, so one interested source becomes the record
tuples.evidence_lens: printed reports traced back to the correspondents and letters they drew on

tuples.episode_object: a later scholarly reassessment of a regional upheaval
tuples.mechanism: a framework explaining a whole region by one kingdom's rise is testable against local evidence
tuples.evidence_lens: the framework's claims tested district by district against excavation and archives

tuples.episode_object: a list of tribute due from chiefdoms under a later administration
tuples.time_place_scope: the chiefdoms of Zululand, the later nineteenth century
tuples.mechanism: later tribute lists show which units survived, indirect evidence of earlier absorption
tuples.evidence_lens: tribute lists compared with oral accounts of which chiefdoms were absorbed and when

tuples.episode_object: a burial ground identified by local tradition
tuples.time_place_scope: the Zulu heartland, from the 1820s onward
tuples.mechanism: sites remembered as royal graves anchor later claims about who ruled and by what descent
tuples.evidence_lens: traditions about sites compared with documentary and archaeological dating where possible

tuples.episode_object: an account of the killing of a ruler recorded second hand
tuples.mechanism: a violent succession recorded only by those who gained leaves motive and sequence unverifiable
tuples.evidence_lens: the surviving versions compared for what each teller stood to gain by telling it so

coverage_profiles.subject: the Egyptian state under Muhammad Ali

tuples.episode_object: a village land register recording holdings and assessed dues
tuples.mechanism: surveying every village first gives a ruler the information needed to remove intermediaries
tuples.evidence_lens: survey registers compared with the tax farm contracts they replaced

tuples.episode_object: an order cancelling a tax farm contract
tuples.mechanism: removing tax farmers and salarying officials puts the whole rural surplus in treasury hands
tuples.evidence_lens: cancellation orders compared with treasury receipts before and after the change

tuples.episode_object: an inventory of a religious endowment's revenues
tuples.mechanism: absorbing endowment income removes the independent funding scholars and mosques relied on
tuples.evidence_lens: endowment inventories compared with later state payments to the same institutions

tuples.episode_object: a purchase price schedule for a government crop monopoly
tuples.mechanism: buying a whole crop at a fixed price and selling abroad makes the treasury the only exporter
tuples.evidence_lens: purchase schedules compared with Alexandria export prices for the same seasons

tuples.episode_object: a delivery receipt for long-staple cotton at a state warehouse
tuples.mechanism: a new export crop grown under compulsion ties peasant labour to a price set abroad
tuples.evidence_lens: delivery receipts compared with Liverpool cotton quotations and shipping records

tuples.episode_object: a corvee requisition listing men called for canal work
tuples.time_place_scope: the canal works west of the delta, 1817-1820
tuples.mechanism: digging with drafted labour is cheap in cash and costly in the harvest never planted
tuples.evidence_lens: labour requisitions compared with mortality reports and grain yields in those districts

tuples.episode_object: a conscription list drawn up for a village
tuples.mechanism: drafting cultivators for long service takes the same bodies the fields and canals require
tuples.evidence_lens: conscription lists compared with village population returns over the next decade

tuples.episode_object: a recruitment record for soldiers taken in a southern campaign
tuples.time_place_scope: the Sudan south of the cataracts, 1820-1824
tuples.mechanism: invading for gold and soldiers fails as a manpower plan when recruits die before training ends
tuples.evidence_lens: recruitment and mortality returns compared with the campaign's stated objectives

tuples.episode_object: an arsenal construction account for a naval yard
tuples.mechanism: building warships at home needs imported timber and foreign shipwrights, so autonomy is bought
tuples.evidence_lens: arsenal accounts compared with customs records for timber and naval stores

tuples.episode_object: a state textile mill's output and wastage book
tuples.time_place_scope: the government factories of the delta, 1820s-1830s
tuples.mechanism: factories funded from farm monopolies must sell to the state, no home market absorbing them
tuples.evidence_lens: mill output books compared with army and government procurement records

tuples.episode_object: an enrolment register of a government medical school
tuples.mechanism: training doctors to keep an army alive spreads a health apparatus into civilian districts
tuples.evidence_lens: enrolment and posting records compared with quarantine and vaccination reports

tuples.episode_object: a printed translation of a European technical manual
tuples.time_place_scope: the government press at Bulaq, from the 1820s
tuples.mechanism: translating manuals builds a technical cadre quickly and ties it to state employment
tuples.evidence_lens: press imprint lists compared with the curricula of the schools that used them

tuples.episode_object: a student mission's report on studies abroad
tuples.mechanism: sending students abroad on state stipends returns skills bound by obligation to the sender
tuples.evidence_lens: mission reports compared with the posts the returning students were assigned

tuples.episode_object: an army ration and pay return from a campaign in the field
tuples.mechanism: holding a distant province with conscript armies puts the burden home and the revenue there
tuples.evidence_lens: campaign returns compared with the Egyptian treasury's accounts for those years

tuples.episode_object: a petition from a town against conscription and disarmament
tuples.mechanism: applying a conscription system to a newly held province turns reform into armed revolt
tuples.evidence_lens: petitions and revolt reports compared with recruitment quotas set for each district

tuples.episode_object: a commercial convention text limiting monopolies
tuples.time_place_scope: the Ottoman empire and its provinces, 1838
tuples.mechanism: a treaty banning monopolies removes the fiscal base of state industry while its costs remain
tuples.evidence_lens: the convention's terms compared with monopoly revenue lines in later budgets

tuples.episode_object: a great-power convention text reducing an army by agreement
tuples.mechanism: trading regional conquest for a hereditary title exchanges power abroad for security at home
tuples.evidence_lens: the convention compared with army strength returns of the following years

tuples.episode_object: an imperial decree confirming hereditary succession in one family
tuples.mechanism: a hereditary governorship inside an empire creates a dynasty that must still remit and defer
tuples.evidence_lens: the decree's conditions compared with the tribute actually remitted afterwards

tuples.episode_object: a land assignment granting uncultivated tracts to an official
tuples.mechanism: granting waste land to officials in place of pay creates private estates monopoly had blocked
tuples.evidence_lens: assignment records traced into the landholding registers of the next generation

tuples.episode_object: a quarantine board's shipping inspection record
tuples.time_place_scope: the port of Alexandria, from the 1830s
tuples.mechanism: inspecting every arrival for disease also yields a running record of trade a treasury can tax
tuples.evidence_lens: quarantine records compared with customs declarations for the same vessels

tuples.episode_object: a printed provincial examination pass list
tuples.mechanism: narrow examination quotas push literate ambition outside official careers
tuples.evidence_lens: provincial pass quotas set against registered candidate numbers over successive sittings

tuples.episode_object: a Chinese-language missionary tract for street distribution
tuples.time_place_scope: Canton and its river approaches, the 1840s
tuples.mechanism: cheap vernacular print carries doctrine far past the missionaries who wrote it
tuples.evidence_lens: surviving tract editions matched to mission society printing and distribution accounts

tuples.episode_object: a salt monopoly transport licence
tuples.time_place_scope: the Huai river salt districts, the 1840s
tuples.mechanism: monopoly licences that no longer cover smuggling losses starve the treasury
tuples.evidence_lens: licence issue counts weighed against recorded salt revenue remittances to the capital

tuples.episode_object: a village crop-watching association subscription list
tuples.mechanism: self-defence subscriptions harden lineage and settler feuds into armed factions
tuples.evidence_lens: subscription lists read beside county gazetteer accounts of feud litigation

tuples.episode_object: a banner garrison muster book
tuples.time_place_scope: Nanjing before its capture, the early 1850s
tuples.mechanism: garrison rolls with more names than soldiers leave walls defended on paper
tuples.evidence_lens: muster totals compared with grain ration issues for the same garrison months

tuples.episode_object: a land certificate issued under a rebel land-holding scheme
tuples.time_place_scope: the lower Yangtze delta, the late 1850s and early 1860s
tuples.mechanism: promised redistribution gives way to taxing landlords, since harvest cash comes faster
tuples.evidence_lens: issued certificates set against rent receipts from the same districts and seasons

tuples.episode_object: a river barrier receipt for the lijin transit levy
tuples.mechanism: provincial transit tolls fund new armies locally and drain the capital's fiscal grip
tuples.evidence_lens: toll station receipts against central board of revenue remittance registers

tuples.episode_object: an enlistment roster of a provincially raised militia army
tuples.mechanism: recruiting whole companies through one commander's home ties binds troops to a patron
tuples.evidence_lens: rosters traced for shared county origin and surnames, then for later appointments

tuples.episode_object: a foreign settlement land renter's deed
tuples.mechanism: refugees with capital crowd into a treaty enclave and lift a trading beach into a city
tuples.evidence_lens: land renters' registers and rate assessments read year by year with refugee estimates

tuples.episode_object: a bilingual treaty article on inland travel passes
tuples.mechanism: outside powers press new concessions on a court that cannot afford a second front
tuples.evidence_lens: treaty texts read against court memorials on troop dispositions in the same months

tuples.episode_object: an armoury inventory listing purchased foreign muskets
tuples.mechanism: buying and copying imported firearms creates a standing procurement lobby in provinces
tuples.evidence_lens: arms purchase invoices compared with later arsenal establishment memorials

tuples.episode_object: a printed rebel calendar
tuples.mechanism: an alternative calendar forces every document to declare allegiance, barring neutrality
tuples.evidence_lens: dated local documents surveyed district by district for which calendar they use

tuples.episode_object: a grain tribute shipment tally from the canal route
tuples.time_place_scope: the Grand Canal north of Jiangsu, the 1850s
tuples.mechanism: cutting the canal grain artery rebuilds northern supply around coastal shipping firms
tuples.evidence_lens: canal tribute tallies against sea transport contracts and coastal shipping records

tuples.episode_object: an examination hall repair estimate filed after recapture
tuples.time_place_scope: Zhejiang cities retaken in the mid 1860s
tuples.mechanism: reopening examination halls first signals gentry status will hold, buying back consent
tuples.evidence_lens: repair estimates and reopening dates matched to resumed local tax collection

tuples.episode_object: a foreign-officered contingent's pay chit
tuples.mechanism: paying foreign-led units from local revenue entrenches provincial military autonomy
tuples.evidence_lens: pay chits set beside the funding memorials of the merchants who paid the unit

tuples.episode_object: a charitable hall relief grain distribution register
tuples.mechanism: gentry relief bodies fill the gap left by broken county offices and keep the role
tuples.evidence_lens: relief registers compared with county staffing lists before and after the fighting

tuples.episode_object: a resettlement land grant to migrants from another province
tuples.time_place_scope: depopulated districts of Anhui and Jiangsu, the 1860s and 1870s
tuples.mechanism: granting empty land to incoming settlers rebuilds a tax base with a different society
tuples.evidence_lens: grant registers read against surname and dialect distributions in later gazetteers

tuples.episode_object: a prefectural population return compiled for tax purposes
tuples.time_place_scope: the Yangtze provinces in the decades after 1864
tuples.mechanism: post-war returns count who can be taxed, not who lives, so loss estimates shift
tuples.evidence_lens: returns from before and after weighed with the twenty to seventy million range

tuples.episode_object: a shipyard construction account for a steam vessel
tuples.time_place_scope: Fuzhou and Shanghai, from the late 1860s
tuples.mechanism: arsenals funded by governors become the first modern plants, owned outside the ministries
tuples.evidence_lens: shipyard accounts compared with the provincial revenue streams that funded them

tuples.episode_object: an early republican school textbook chapter on the mid-century wars
tuples.mechanism: later movements reread a failed rising as precedent, and that shapes what is preserved
tuples.evidence_lens: successive textbook editions set against archives assembled in the same decades

tuples.episode_object: a police report on a banned banquet subscription
tuples.mechanism: banning a fundraising banquet turns a legal reform campaign into a street fight
tuples.evidence_lens: prefecture police files set against the subscription lists banquet committees kept

tuples.episode_object: a grain price table posted at a market hall
tuples.mechanism: two bad harvests lift bread prices past urban wages just before the political break
tuples.evidence_lens: market price series compared with artisan wage books from the same towns

tuples.episode_object: a railway share prospectus from the mid-1840s
tuples.mechanism: a construction boom ending in credit contraction idles skilled men in the rising cities
tuples.evidence_lens: share issue records read with railway employment returns and bank failure notices

tuples.episode_object: a National Guard enrolment register
tuples.mechanism: a citizen militia that will not fire removes the last instrument short of the army
tuples.evidence_lens: enrolment registers compared with orders issued to guard legions in February

tuples.episode_object: a decree establishing state-funded workshops
tuples.mechanism: work promised as a right builds a payroll no provisional treasury can carry
tuples.evidence_lens: workshop enrolment and wage payments weighed against treasury daily balances

tuples.episode_object: a printed constitutional patent granted by a monarch
tuples.mechanism: a hastily granted charter buys weeks of calm and concedes that a text binds a crown
tuples.evidence_lens: successive drafts of the patents compared with court council minutes that fortnight

tuples.episode_object: a post office and telegraph despatch book
tuples.time_place_scope: the German states, March and April 1848
tuples.mechanism: news of one capital's concession arrives in days, setting deadlines in every other
tuples.evidence_lens: despatch arrival times matched to the dates of concessions in each capital

tuples.episode_object: an election return for a delegate to a national assembly
tuples.time_place_scope: Frankfurt and the electing districts, the spring of 1848
tuples.mechanism: indirect election through notables yields an assembly of lawyers with no troops
tuples.evidence_lens: returns analysed by occupation of the elected against each state's franchise rules

tuples.episode_object: a manorial dues redemption schedule
tuples.mechanism: compensated abolition of labour dues detaches the countryside from the urban movement
tuples.evidence_lens: redemption schedules compared with the geography of rural unrest that autumn

tuples.episode_object: a ministry ordinance printed in Magyar
tuples.mechanism: a government legislating in one language turns other speakers into an armed counter-force
tuples.evidence_lens: language ordinances set against recruitment for Croatian and Serbian formations

tuples.episode_object: a bilingual proclamation to a mixed-language province
tuples.time_place_scope: the Czech lands, the summer of 1848
tuples.mechanism: claiming a language frontier as a state frontier fails where populations interleave
tuples.evidence_lens: proclamation print runs by language weighed against parish language returns

tuples.episode_object: an artillery expenditure return from a siege
tuples.mechanism: once a field army still obeys, a besieged capital's gains lose their guarantor
tuples.evidence_lens: ammunition returns and casualty lists read with the court's relocation letters

tuples.episode_object: a republican paper currency note
tuples.mechanism: a republic without tax machinery prints paper, and the discount measures its life
tuples.evidence_lens: note issue totals compared with the discount recorded by Roman bankers

tuples.episode_object: an expeditionary force embarkation list
tuples.time_place_scope: Civitavecchia and Rome, the spring of 1849
tuples.mechanism: restoring a foreign monarch shows domestic order outranking exported principle
tuples.evidence_lens: embarkation lists read against the assembly debates authorising the expedition

tuples.episode_object: an intervention army's supply contract
tuples.time_place_scope: Hungary and Galicia, the summer of 1849

tuples.episode_object: successive drafting committee versions of a constitution's articles

tuples.mechanism: an opinion on whether a declaration breached law leaves recognition to states to decide
tuples.evidence_lens: the advisory opinion text compared with the pattern of recognitions before and after

coverage_profiles.subject: the Rwandan genocide and state collapse

tuples.episode_object: an identity card printed with a line for ethnic group
tuples.time_place_scope: Rwanda under Belgian administration, from the 1930s
tuples.mechanism: recording a fluid social category on a document makes it fixed, inherited and checkable
tuples.evidence_lens: card series and administrative circulars compared with earlier colonial census practice

tuples.episode_object: a mission school admission register with quota columns
tuples.mechanism: reserving schooling for one designated group builds the grievance that later politics uses
tuples.evidence_lens: admission registers compared with civil service appointment lists of the same decades

tuples.episode_object: a movement return recording departures to neighbouring territories
tuples.mechanism: expelling a population without settling its status creates an exiled claim that returns
tuples.evidence_lens: movement returns compared with camp registrations kept in the receiving territories

tuples.episode_object: a coffee export price schedule set by a marketing board
tuples.mechanism: a fall in one export crop's price removes the rural income state patronage rested on
tuples.evidence_lens: board price schedules compared with world prices and household income surveys

tuples.episode_object: a loan condition list attached to an adjustment programme
tuples.mechanism: devaluation and fee introduction during a war raise prices for people already displaced
tuples.evidence_lens: condition schedules compared with consumer price data and public spending accounts

tuples.episode_object: a front's mobilisation order for a crossing from a neighbouring state
tuples.mechanism: an invasion by exiles gives a government the argument that its critics are its enemies
tuples.evidence_lens: military records compared with the arrest lists compiled in the weeks after the crossing

tuples.episode_object: a peace accord protocol on integrating two armies into one
tuples.mechanism: a power-sharing text that halves an officer corps gives that corps a reason to break it
tuples.evidence_lens: the protocols compared with officer establishment tables and later obstruction reporting

tuples.episode_object: a broadcasting licence granted to a private radio station
tuples.mechanism: a licensed station repeating names and locations turns broadcasting into a targeting tool
tuples.evidence_lens: recorded broadcasts compared with the tribunal's findings on incitement in the media case

tuples.episode_object: an airway bill for an arms consignment cleared at an airport
tuples.mechanism: importing small arms and blades in bulk equips a mass action no army needs to conduct
tuples.evidence_lens: customs and airway records compared with the commission of experts' arms inventory

tuples.episode_object: a peacekeeping force's rules of engagement and troop ceiling
tuples.mechanism: a mandate barring seizure of weapons leaves a force able to observe but not prevent
tuples.evidence_lens: cables from the force commander compared with the mandate texts and troop returns

tuples.episode_object: a resolution reducing an authorised force in the middle of a crisis
tuples.mechanism: withdrawing observers while killing accelerates removes the last constraint on the ground
tuples.evidence_lens: the resolution and its debate record compared with the reporting available that week

tuples.episode_object: a roadblock checking list used against identity documents
tuples.time_place_scope: the roads of Rwanda, April to July 1994
tuples.mechanism: a document check at every junction converts a state's paperwork into a killing apparatus
tuples.evidence_lens: checkpoint locations mapped against tribunal findings and survivor route testimony

tuples.episode_object: a commune requisition for vehicles, fuel and communal labour
tuples.time_place_scope: Butare and Gikongoro prefectures, April and May 1994
tuples.mechanism: administering an atrocity through ordinary local government makes it fast and traceable
tuples.evidence_lens: commune requisition books compared with the prosecutions brought against officials

tuples.episode_object: an operation's zone map drawn for a foreign intervention force
tuples.mechanism: a protected zone late in a war shelters civilians and retreating perpetrators together
tuples.evidence_lens: zone records compared with the composition of the population that crossed the border

tuples.episode_object: a camp ration card issued in a neighbouring country
tuples.mechanism: feeding a camp whose leadership is armed subsidises the structure that will fight again
tuples.evidence_lens: ration distribution figures compared with agency reporting on camp command structures

tuples.episode_object: a cholera treatment centre's admissions log
tuples.mechanism: a mass arrival onto volcanic rock without water turns displacement into an epidemic
tuples.evidence_lens: admission logs and burial counts compared with water supply capacity at the site

tuples.episode_object: a tribunal judgment defining a crime by the intent behind it
tuples.mechanism: a court must prove intent, so it converts a mass event into individually attributable acts
tuples.evidence_lens: judgments read against the evidentiary standard applied and the acquittals recorded

tuples.episode_object: a community court docket listing cases heard in the open air
tuples.mechanism: trying a million cases locally trades procedural depth for a rate the prisons required
tuples.evidence_lens: docket counts and outcomes compared with prison population figures across the decade

tuples.episode_object: a census return and the demographic projections built from it
tuples.mechanism: estimating deaths from population data yields a range whose width depends on the baseline
tuples.evidence_lens: the 1991 census compared with later surveys, giving estimates from about 500,000 upward

tuples.episode_object: a survivors' fund payment record for school fees and housing
tuples.mechanism: compensating through a levy on salaries makes recovery a permanent budget line
tuples.evidence_lens: fund disbursements compared with the levy's yield and the register of beneficiaries

coverage_profiles.subject: the collapse of the Somali state

tuples.episode_object: a boundary protocol map dividing a pastoral range between empires
tuples.mechanism: borders drawn across seasonal grazing routes leave every later government's claim partial
tuples.evidence_lens: protocol maps compared with recorded transhumance routes and grazing dispute records

tuples.episode_object: an act of union joining two former colonial territories
tuples.mechanism: merging two administrations with different legal codes leaves one capital holding the posts
tuples.evidence_lens: the union instruments compared with 1961 referendum returns region by region

tuples.episode_object: a literacy primer printed in a newly standardised script
tuples.mechanism: writing a spoken language for the first time lets a state address rural people directly
tuples.evidence_lens: primer print runs compared with literacy campaign reports and later enrolment figures

tuples.episode_object: a military assistance agreement transferring aircraft and advisers
tuples.mechanism: an army built by a patron outgrows the economy that has to feed it once the patron leaves
tuples.evidence_lens: transfer schedules compared with defence spending as a share of the national budget

tuples.episode_object: a casualty and equipment loss return from a failed offensive
tuples.mechanism: defeat in a war of national claim turns an army's officers into its first opposition
tuples.evidence_lens: loss returns compared with the coup attempt records and detentions of the following year

tuples.episode_object: a feeding centre register from a camp for people displaced by drought
tuples.mechanism: an aid economy larger than the export economy makes relief the main resource to control
tuples.evidence_lens: camp registers compared with aid inflow figures and recorded livestock export earnings

tuples.episode_object: an officer's pension arrears schedule
tuples.mechanism: unpaid soldiers keep their weapons and begin charging the public for what the state owed
tuples.evidence_lens: payroll and arrears records compared with reporting on checkpoints and irregular levies

tuples.episode_object: a damage survey of a bombarded northern city
tuples.mechanism: a government shelling its own second city forfeits any claim to represent that region
tuples.evidence_lens: damage surveys and displacement counts compared with later commission of inquiry findings

tuples.episode_object: an aircraft departure record from a capital under attack
tuples.mechanism: a ruler's flight without a successor leaves ministries as buildings, not institutions
tuples.evidence_lens: departure records compared with ministry asset inventories taken afterwards

tuples.episode_object: a conference resolution adopted by clan elders in a northern town
tuples.mechanism: elders' assemblies can constitute an authority where no army has won and none can be paid
tuples.evidence_lens: conference resolutions compared with the sequence of later reconciliation gatherings

tuples.episode_object: a checkpoint toll receipt written out by an armed group
tuples.mechanism: taxing movement pays a militia without requiring it to govern anything at all
tuples.evidence_lens: toll rates recorded by convoy operators compared with relief delivery cost accounts

tuples.episode_object: a nutrition survey of a district between two front lines
tuples.mechanism: famine concentrates where cultivators are neither armed nor aligned with either side
tuples.evidence_lens: district nutrition surveys compared with harvest data and militia control maps

tuples.episode_object: a relief convoy manifest with its armed escort contract
tuples.mechanism: paying for protection to deliver food makes the deliverer a source of income to fight over
tuples.evidence_lens: escort contracts and manifests compared with looting incident logs kept by agencies

tuples.episode_object: a mandate resolution authorising force to secure relief deliveries
tuples.mechanism: protecting convoys is achievable, while disarming those who tax them is a different war
tuples.evidence_lens: the mandate text compared with delivery tonnages before and after the deployment

tuples.episode_object: an after action report on a raid and the losses it produced
tuples.mechanism: casualties in an unwinnable pursuit convert a foreign public into a withdrawal timetable
tuples.evidence_lens: the after action reports compared with the withdrawal decisions taken within days

tuples.episode_object: a remittance transfer slip from an informal money network
tuples.time_place_scope: the Somali diaspora and gulf ports, the 1990s
tuples.mechanism: private transfer networks can move money reliably without any central bank behind them
tuples.evidence_lens: transfer volumes estimated by surveys compared with household income studies

tuples.episode_object: an animal health certificate required for a livestock shipment
tuples.mechanism: an import ban on livestock removes the one export a stateless economy still depended on
tuples.evidence_lens: export tonnages before and after the bans compared with pastoral household incomes

tuples.episode_object: a charter drafted at a reconciliation conference held abroad
tuples.mechanism: assemblies convened outside the country produce governments that cannot enter it
tuples.evidence_lens: conference charters compared with the territory each resulting body actually administered

tuples.episode_object: an operator licence issued by a regional administration to a phone company
tuples.mechanism: regional authorities that can license and tax build services a central claimant cannot
tuples.evidence_lens: licences and tariff records compared with subscriber growth and revenue reporting

tuples.episode_object: a food security classification bulletin declaring famine in two regions
tuples.mechanism: denying access to relief agencies turns a drought into a famine with a datable start
tuples.evidence_lens: classification bulletins compared with a retrospective mortality estimate near 250,000

tuples.episode_object: a world food price index series for cereals
tuples.time_place_scope: the Middle East and North Africa, 2007-2011
tuples.mechanism: importing most of a staple exposes a subsidy budget to prices no government sets
tuples.evidence_lens: import volumes and price series compared with subsidy spending in each importing state

tuples.episode_object: a municipal inspection record for unlicensed street trading
tuples.mechanism: informal work policed by fines makes local administration the point where anger lands
tuples.evidence_lens: inspection and fine records compared with informal employment estimates for the region

tuples.episode_object: a graduate unemployment series broken down by qualification
tuples.mechanism: expanding higher education faster than formal jobs produces organised, connected claimants
tuples.evidence_lens: labour force survey data compared with university enrolment and public hiring figures

tuples.episode_object: an interior ministry order restricting assembly in a capital
tuples.mechanism: an order the police will not enforce is the moment a government stops being obeyed
tuples.evidence_lens: ministry orders compared with police union statements and deployment records

tuples.episode_object: a border routing table showing a country's networks withdrawn
tuples.mechanism: cutting a national network pushes coordination onto streets that are harder to police
tuples.evidence_lens: routing archives compared with crowd size reporting before and after the outage

tuples.episode_object: a state broadcaster's running order revised during a crisis
tuples.mechanism: a monopoly broadcaster loses its audience the moment a rival channel shows the same square
tuples.evidence_lens: running orders compared with satellite channel schedules and audience measurement data

tuples.episode_object: a military council communique issued to a broadcasting service
tuples.mechanism: an army that declines to fire inherits the authority it declined to defend
tuples.evidence_lens: the communiques compared with the constitutional articles suspended in the same week

tuples.episode_object: a referendum ballot on amendments to an existing constitution
tuples.mechanism: amending a charter first, and writing a new one later, favours the already organised
tuples.evidence_lens: governorate returns compared with the later parliamentary results in the same areas

tuples.episode_object: a compensation claim file opened for those killed in protests
tuples.mechanism: recognising victims by statute creates a register that later prosecutions must address
tuples.evidence_lens: claim registers compared with prosecution files and forensic reports on the same deaths

tuples.episode_object: a seat allocation table for a constituent assembly election
tuples.mechanism: electing a body to write a constitution makes the drafting itself subject to coalition
tuples.evidence_lens: allocation tables compared with the assembly's recorded votes on contested articles

tuples.episode_object: a national dialogue roadmap signed by parties and unions
tuples.mechanism: unions and employers brokering a deadlock supply legitimacy that parties had exhausted
tuples.evidence_lens: the roadmap text compared with the constitution adopted and the cabinet that followed it

tuples.episode_object: a local police detention register from a provincial town
tuples.mechanism: detentions in a provincial town spread a protest through kinship links the capital lacks
tuples.evidence_lens: detention registers compared with the sequence of towns where protests next appeared

tuples.episode_object: a resolution authorising measures to protect civilians in a conflict
tuples.mechanism: a civilian protection mandate read as permission to change a government sets a precedent
tuples.evidence_lens: the resolution text compared with the target sets in the air campaign that followed

tuples.episode_object: an air tasking order for operations over a closed airspace
tuples.mechanism: air power decides a ground war only where a local force already holds territory
tuples.evidence_lens: tasking records compared with the sequence of towns changing hands on the ground

tuples.episode_object: an exclusion law barring former officials from public office
tuples.mechanism: excluding the administrative class removes the officials a new ministry needs to function
tuples.evidence_lens: the law's criteria compared with the number of posts vacated in each ministry

tuples.episode_object: an oil terminal loading record showing months without a cargo
tuples.mechanism: whoever holds an export terminal holds the only revenue a rentier government has
tuples.evidence_lens: loading records compared with central bank receipts and public salary payment dates

tuples.episode_object: an independent commission's report into the policing of protests
tuples.mechanism: a commission with published findings binds a government to a record it must answer to
tuples.evidence_lens: the commission's findings compared with the implementation reporting that followed

tuples.episode_object: a transfer of powers agreement brokered by a regional council
tuples.mechanism: an immunity-for-departure deal removes a ruler while leaving his networks in the army
tuples.evidence_lens: the agreement text compared with the officer corps composition in the following years

tuples.episode_object: a dialogue conference outcome document on federal regions
tuples.mechanism: a settlement that redraws regions without agreeing resources reopens the original fight
tuples.evidence_lens: the outcome document compared with the territorial control map a year afterwards

tuples.episode_object: a refugee registration file opened in a neighbouring country
tuples.mechanism: prolonged displacement moves a conflict's costs onto states with no part in its politics
tuples.evidence_lens: registration totals compared with host state budget and labour market statistics
